keyFindings.description: GitHub reports PR #2323 CONFLICTING (mergeStateStatus DIRTY) against main 2e8c68cd98ce: `git merge-tree` shows content conflicts in packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md and packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/store/pool.go, and main's #2137 adds migration 0129_document_edit_notices, the number this branch gives 0129_server_processes (0130_dashboard_assets follows). GitHub runs no checks on a conflicting head, so the required checks cannot settle. Forward-merge main, renumber both migrations (in step with INFRA-555's #2390), resolve pool.go's lease-pool size against main's.

deploymentChanged (line 86) compares live[0], always an entry path /assets/index-*.js, with runningIndexAsset(), which falls back to __DISPATCH_BUILD__ (line 66) when the page has no /assets/index-*.js script (Vite dev server). Under `bun run dev` with a backend on :8766 that serves any built web/dist, the route answers one live entry and the tab shows 'A new version is available' on every focus; a reload brings it back. Before this change the old code read `/` from the dev server, found no index asset and offered nothing. Fix: offer nothing when the page names no entry chunk, plus a unit test of that case.

Hardening, no exploit path: readRetainedAsset's flight runs on context.WithoutCancel (line 595) while the 8 MiB reservation is released when the handler returns, so a client that disconnects at once leaves a store lookup running outside the memory cap's concurrency bound. Lookups are sub-millisecond primary-key reads; not a gate.

ci: Required set (rulesets): lint, typecheck, test, pr-title; branch protection none. CI head dc41305784ba (compare to f169f43e: 2 files, handoffsOnly true): typecheck success, lint and test in_progress, pr-title queued. Not green; the conflict blocks the head regardless.
thermonuclear: Pair run once at f169f43e (code dc41305784ba): deep review CHANGES (the dev-notice finding, Minor detached-read hardening, everything else clean incl. DISPATCH_DEV_SIGNIN_SHARED_KEY refused without dev sign-in at cmd/dispatch/main.go:688, path cleaned and parameterized, publish/prune advisory locks); code quality CHANGES on cleanup only (reload budget in two copies as the plan accepted, LiveDashboardBuilds in package api and BuildID re-reading index.html because INFRA-555's processes package is frozen on #2390, assetCache flight in router, duplicate size check, dead top-level testIgnore) - none changes behaviour; not requested.
